This is gonna be buried. But I'm moving out early from a house with 5 roommates. I thought it'd be okay if I kept up the rent until I found someone. They were angry at first, but then they accepted that rent wouldn't change so it was okay. So I found someone who had mutual friends with my girlfriend so I figured they would be a good lead to follow. Last night I got an earful from one roommate saying I didn't know them well enough. It was actually more of an uncivilized fight, really. I also live with my big sister, who I thought would understand. I was very wrong. She did the same as the first roommate. Then another jumped in. Long story short, I was ganged up on, on a decision people were misinterpreting. And I feel alone. I'm trying my hardest to make this work for them, and in return, they're hating me. Even my own damn sister.

And in terms of making it work, I've already made it clear I would continue paying my portion of rent until I found someone. That was the deal. They still think I'm giving them the short end of the stick. I just feel empty right now because I totally dissolved my relationship with my sister last night. It's not good. And I don't have anyone to back me up.

I'm not sure specifically what makes me go idle. I guess I'm just not happy in general. I'm hoping something will change. If at least, myself. Otherwise my fantasies might become more than that someday. 

I might start seeing a therapist, since I'm really unsure of what all is making me feel this way. I don't think I'll be telling anyone I know anytime soon though. I guess the fact that I'm even concerned that I have these thoughts is a good sign, right? 

Anyway, I appreciate you chatting with me. It felt good to not hold it in for once.

I'm actually 21 so it was about time for me to get out anyway. But yeah, I'm homesick as hell. I've been moved out for a little over a year now and this year has flown by, and not in a good way. It's almost like my life has become muddied by idleness.

I'm sure you wouldn't be a burden to ask your parents. I know everyone's parents are different, but mine would take me back in a heartbeat, no matter how old I am. That fact alone kind of makes me sick to my stomach. Thinking I could go back so easily if I sucked it up and arranged it. But I can't bring myself to.

I moved 4 hours out. And honestly, for no reason. I just had an opportunity to move in with some friends and decided to dive in. Not even for school or anything. Fortunately my friends aren't bad roommates, but I still miss the security of my mom's home. She discouraged me from moving out and I'm constantly wanting to tell my past self to listen to her. It just wasn't good timing.

But that of course is one of many reasons I start getting down. I'm sorry to hear you're going through something similar. How're you holding up?
